respuesta.historial_usuario: Hi, I'm going through the demand-forecast-docs latest documentation because I'm joining the marketplace forecasting team and need to get up to speed on the explicabilidad part of the project.
respuesta.historial_asistente: Welcome aboard! Ask me anything you want to clarify about the explicabilidad docs and I'll look it up.
respuesta.pregunta: I keep seeing "Diarización" in the sidebar. Which kind of variables does that step deal with, and what granularity do they start at?
respuesta.respuesta: "Diarización" is the dailyization of exogenous variables that come at a monthly granularity. The section explains how those monthly exogenous variables are turned into daily ones [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/explicabilidad/diarizacion.md:L1-L3]. The docs give the reason: the project works with daily data, but some future exogenous variables are only available at a monthly level. To use them in the models, they have to be broken down to a daily level [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/explicabilidad/diarizacion.md:L29].
answer_checks: Calls the tool with demand-forecast-docs and version latest from the history, without asking for the software or version again.
States that Diarización/dailyization applies to exogenous variables that are available monthly.
Indicates that the goal is to disaggregate them to a daily level because the project uses daily data.
Cites the diarizacion.md document (title/intro lines and/or the Motivation line).
Does not invent details about the target series or other variable types that the documents do not state.
